title: Ledger
challenge: A finance tool for small business owners, launching into a category of blue gradients, abstract icons and promises of “financial freedom”.
insight: Owners didn’t want to feel excited about their accounts. They wanted to feel in control, the way a good accountant makes you feel.
idea: We made clarity the brand. A plain-spoken voice, a grid borrowed from traditional ledger books, and one bold colour used with discipline across product, website and pitch.
outcome: A finance brand that sounds like a trusted adviser, not a sales pitch.
